heading.title: Provisions as to Bail and Bonds

article.title: Power to order sufficient bail when that first taken is insufficient
article.content: If, through mistake, fraud or otherwise, insufficient sureties have been accepted, or if they afterwards become insufficient, the Court may issue a warrant of arrest directing that the person released on bail be brought before it and may order him to find sufficient sureties, and, on his failing so to do, may commit him to jail.
article.html:
488Power to order sufficient bail when that first taken is insufficient

Section 488 · Chapter XXXV

If, through mistake, fraud or otherwise, insufficient sureties have been accepted, or if they afterwards become insufficient, the Court may issue a warrant of arrest directing that the person released on bail be brought before it and may order him to find sufficient sureties, and, on his failing so to do, may commit him to jail.
